ShadText.name: ShadText
ShadText.description: Paragraph, lead, muted or small text. Typeface styles: fontFamily ('theme', 'sans', 'serif', 'display' or 'mono'), fontWeight, fontSize (px), letterSpacing (px or em) and textTransform (a small uppercase eyebrow: tone small, textTransform 'uppercase', letterSpacing '0.12em')

authoringHints.styles: Every style falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in (its accent, surfaces, borders and text colours), taking colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product. Radii and sizes are px. Styles are the way to restyle a pack widget: a cssClass only takes effect with workspace Custom styles, and Tailwind class names the pack does not already use are not compiled, so do not rely on either; for a one-off visual a style cannot express, use an Html component. Bind loadingState to the query's isLoading (each widget draws a skeleton or spinner in its own shape); tooltip shows on hover.

Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

renderingHints.recommendedMinHeightPx: ≈110–120 for a compact tile with no visible secondary content; ≈130–150 with useful secondary content
renderingHints.recommendedMinWidthCols: At least 12 for a value-only tile with hideSecondary=true; at least 18 when secondary content is visible. Prefer at most three value-only or two secondary-content tiles per content row.
renderingHints.narrowValueOnlyLabel: A 12–17 column value-only tile is safe only for a short one- or two-word primaryValueLabel (roughly 12 characters or fewer). Longer labels can wrap vertically and hide the value; shorten them, use at least 18 columns, or browser-verify.
renderingHints.secondaryValueUsage: secondaryValue renders in a narrow delta slot: reserve it for a number or percentage. Put prose in secondaryValueLabel and leave secondaryValue empty.

visibleRowCapacity.formula: minimum static height ≈ fixed chrome + rowsPerPage × row height
visibleRowCapacity.rule: If authored height is smaller, the page rows remain reachable through an inner scrollbar but appear clipped. Reduce rowsPerPage, use dynamicHeight, or increase the authored height.

authoringHints.look: styles.tableLook "shadcn" draws this Table in the ToolJet UI 2.0 look (card frame, search-first toolbar, quiet header, hairline rows, UI 2.0 buttons and pagination); use it for tables in apps built in ToolJet UI 2.0. Properties, columns, row action buttons, events and exposed values are the Table's own in both looks.
authoringHints.rowActionDisplay: In the UI 2.0 table look a button column takes buttonDisplay: 'icons' (32px ghost icon buttons, the label as tooltip) for one to three actions every row needs at a glance (View, Edit, Delete), or 'menu' (one '...' button at the row's right edge opening a dropdown) for three or more actions or rarely used ones; 'buttons' (default) keeps labelled buttons, for a single primary row action ('Check in', 'Approve'). Icons come from buttonIconName with buttonIconVisibility true, else from the label's verb (Edit pencil, Delete trash, View eye, Approve check, Send, Export, Copy, Archive...): give every button a short verb label. Delete, Remove and Reject draw in the destructive colour, set apart at the end of the menu. Events, rowData bindings (buttonVisibility, disableButton) and selectedRow work as for labelled buttons; leave name empty or 'Actions' and do not pin it. The ToolJet look ignores buttonDisplay.
authoringHints.checkboxSelection: For bulk actions (approve, export, assign, delete several rows) turn on showBulkSelector: the table draws a checkbox column with a select-all box in the header (the UI 2.0 checkbox in that look). Read components.<table>.selectedRows (the row objects) and selectedRowsId; put the bulk action in a ShadButton above the table whose text counts them ('Approve 3') and whose disabledState is {{!(components.<table>.selectedRows || []).length}}; onSelectionChanged fires on each change. Keep allowSelection on. After the action runs, refresh the data query (the selection clears with new data). A checkbox column is for acting on several rows; for opening one record, use onRowClicked.

serverSideDataFlow.reactiveReadRule: When page/count options reference Table or external-filter exposed state, prefer runOnDependencyChange=true so reads occur after the new state is published. Keep onPageLoad for initial hydration and onRefresh for explicit refresh.
serverSideDataFlow.initialPageGuard: pageIndex can be undefined when a page-load query first evaluates. For offset pagination use ((components.<table>.pageIndex || 1) - 1) * pageSize, or an equivalent nullish guard; the unguarded subtraction produces NaN and an empty table.
serverSideDataFlow.eventRule: With reactive reads, onPageChanged/onSearch/onSort/onFilterChanged and external-filter events should not also run those queries. Use them only for non-query effects such as resetting pageIndex to 1; duplicate wiring causes redundant or stale reads.

runtimeCompatibility.rule: For explicit static columns, keep table-level autogenerateColumns=true and useDynamicColumn=false. MCP normalizes these defaults because some ToolJet versions crash while generating column transformations when autogenerateColumns is false.

dataProjection.rule: With explicit columns and autogenerateColumns=true, bind data to a new object containing only visible and behavior-needed keys. A .map(r => r) identity map or {...r} spread is not a projection and can leak undeclared datasource fields.

hiddenDataColumns.rule: When a field is needed by row actions or selectedRow but must not display, keep it in Table data and declare it in columns with columnVisibility=false. This preserves the key while preventing autogenerateColumns from leaking it as a visible column.

inlineEditing.selection: selectedRow and rowData contain the original source row, not the pending inline edits. selectRowOnCellEdit does not change this contract.
inlineEditing.pendingRows: Read pending full rows with Object.values(components.<table>.dataUpdates || {}). dataUpdates and changeSet are objects keyed by row indexes, not database primary keys; updatedData contains all rows with edits merged.
inlineEditing.saveEvent: The native Save changes footer fires onBulkUpdate. Wire a supported mutation to that event before exposing the footer; an editable cell or visible Save control alone does not persist anything.
inlineEditing.perRowSave: For a per-row Save action, find the pending row by its stable primary key, not its filtered/sorted position. Use selectedRow only for identity; do not save selectedRow field values as if they were edited values. Hide the bulk footer when it has no separate working handler.
inlineEditing.validation: Validate edited numbers for finite, nonnegative values before writing; reject negative values, recompute derived status fields from the edited values, and refresh/reset edits only after confirmed success. Verify the saved value after reload.

rowActionButtons.recommendedApproach: Add a column with columnType="button"; legacy properties.actions.value is deprecated.
rowActionButtons.catalogActionsMeaning: Top-level schema.actions are control-component runtime methods, not row-action buttons.
rowActionButtons.updateRule: Append this column to the complete current columns array; ToolJet replaces arrays wholesale.

expressionContext.example: Set buttonVisibility to {{rowData.status !== "archived"}} for per-row behavior.

cellExpressionContext.cellValue: The displayed/transformed cell value. For color/visibility rules that need the original field, read rowData.<field> instead.

rowActionButtons.clickBehavior: Clicking sets the Table selectedRow and selectedRowId before event handlers run.
rowActionButtons.eventRule: ref is <column key or name>::<button id>; use components.<table>.selectedRow for source-row identity, not pending inline edits. See inlineEditing before wiring editable-cell saves.

renderingHints.minimumSingleLineHeight: ceil(textSize * lineHeight + 6px) for static height; round up to ToolJet's 10px grid
renderingHints.surfaceInset: Text styles.padding does not provide inner content padding. On a colored card surface, use an HTML wrapper with padding inside textFormat:html, inset native Text within a Container, or center a compact value when appropriate. Include the inset in the authored height; plain transparent labels need no card treatment.
renderingHints.note: The canvas wrapper and Text border consume 6px. A 24px Text at the default 1.5 line-height needs 42px, so the default 40px component clips glyphs/descenders. Use 50px, or dynamicHeight for wrapping content.

renderingHints.formLabelAlignment: Use styles.alignment.value="top" in forms, modals, and fields 18 columns or narrower.
Use styles.alignment.value="top" in forms, modals, and fields 18 columns or narrower.
renderingHints.compactFormHeight: Use the harvested defaultSize.height (normally 40px) for a standard single-line field. With a top label it occupies about 60px; use a 70px top-to-top row step for a 10px gap.
renderingHints.valueTextSizing: Authored height does not enlarge the value text. Only labelFontSize is exposed; oversized fields make the unchanged value text look too small.
